GIFT_SUBTITLE: Hides the gift button in the chat input.
EMPTY_SEND_SUBTITLE: Hides the send button until you type something or attach a file.
VOICE_MESSAGE_SUBTITLE: Hides the microphone that records a voice message.
VOICE_CALL_SUBTITLE: Hides the call buttons in DM headers and on profiles.
VIDEO_CALL_SUBTITLE: Hides the video call buttons in DM headers.
QUESTS_SUBTITLE: Hides Quests from the bar on the You screen.
SHOP_SUBTITLE: Hides the Shop from the bar on the You screen.
SERVER_BOOSTS_SUBTITLE: Hides Server Boosts at the top of a server's channel list.
NITRO_BUTTON_SUBTITLE: Hides Nitro from the bar on the You screen.
ORBS_BALANCE_SUBTITLE: Hides the Orbs balance on the You screen.
BOOST_GOAL_SUBTITLE: Hides the boost goal at the top of a server's channel list.
AVATAR_DECORATIONS_SUBTITLE: Hides decorations around avatars in chat and on profiles.
NAMEPLATES_SUBTITLE: Hides the nameplates behind names in the member and DM lists.
SERVER_TAGS_SUBTITLE: Hides server tags beside names in chat, voice and on profiles.
DISPLAY_NAME_STYLES_SUBTITLE: Shows display names in the plain font and colour.
PROFILE_TABS_SUBTITLE: Hides the Wishlist, Board and Activity tabs on profiles.
SERVER_THEMES_SUBTITLE: Shows servers in your own theme instead of their server theme.
DM_ACTIVITY_CARDS_SUBTITLE: Hides the Happening Now cards above your DM list.
PAYMENT_NITRO_SUBTITLE: Hides the Nitro pages in User Settings.
PAYMENT_SHOP_SUBTITLE: Hides the Shop page in User Settings.
PAYMENT_QUESTS_SUBTITLE: Hides the Quests page in User Settings.
PAYMENT_SUBSCRIPTIONS_SUBTITLE: Hides Manage Subscriptions and server subscriptions in User Settings.
PAYMENT_BOOSTS_SUBTITLE: Hides the Server Boost page in User Settings.
PAYMENT_GIFTS_SUBTITLE: Hides the Gift Inventory page in User Settings.
